_comment: n8n queue/retry NODE SKETCH only — a fragment, NOT a full workflow. Node names are illustrative; the implementing builder wires real nodes, credentials via env/vault references (never literal values), and final retry/delay numbers. Fake placeholders only. FIXED PER REVIEW (awaiting re-review, not live/proven): explicit ToS/robots ban = HARD STOP with no override (pattern doc 1.1); CAPTCHA auto-solve banned outright; section 3 measures pre-block only, forbidden after a block.

nodes.name: Schedule-or-Webhook-Trigger
nodes.notes: Starts a sync run. One run per supplier per schedule; never all suppliers in one blast.

nodes.name: Enqueue-Items
nodes.notes: One queue item per supplier SKU/page: {supplier, skuOrPageId, listingUrl, profileRef, attempt: 0}. Queue-based logic manages retries/failures better than running everything in one go [topic-122967, Jue reply].

nodes.name: Dequeue-One
nodes.notes: Process items one (or few) at a time. A single item failure never blocks the queue.

nodes.name: Wait-Random-Delay
nodes.notes: Random jittered delay before each fetch [topic-176926 reply: random delays]. Builder sets the range; never a fixed interval.

nodes.name: Fetch-via-Antidetect-Browser-or-HTTP
nodes.notes: Browser path only when JS rendering is genuinely needed [topic-122967]; otherwise HTTP Request node with real browser headers [topic-176926 reply]. Proxy: rotating residential, referenced by env var name only, e.g. $env.SUPPLIER_PROXY_HOST_EXAMPLE. Antidetect API key: vault/env reference only, e.g. $env.ANTIDETECT_API_KEY_EXAMPLE — never a literal. SECTION 3 MEASURES (proxies, antidetect fingerprints, browser headers) are permitted ONLY before any block event for this supplier and FORBIDDEN after one for resuming a paused scrape; their use requires a per-supplier approved-risk record (approver + date + reasoning + scope) — pattern doc section 3. Never an authenticated session cookie in a profile (section 2/F6).

nodes.name: Classify-Outcome
nodes.notes: Route by outcome: success -> Extract-Delta; retryable (network error, 5xx, timeout, attempt < 3) -> Requeue-With-Backoff; fatal (403/block page, CAPTCHA, login wall, bot-control response) -> Dead-Letter directly, NO retry, supplier queue PAUSED, human escalation. Classification fires on block/CAPTCHA — never auto-retry into a control, never auto-solve a CAPTCHA (pattern doc section 6: NO automated solving against explicit bot controls, period; human manual solving only, per challenge, logged). After a block event, section 3 measures are FORBIDDEN for resuming the paused scrape.

nodes.name: Requeue-With-Backoff
nodes.notes: attempt = attempt + 1, with backoff + jitter. At attempt cap, route to Dead-Letter instead.

nodes.name: Extract-Delta
nodes.notes: Per-batch work in a sub-workflow returning only a short result [topic-308744]. Output per item: supplier ID, listing URL, and CHANGED fields only — never full product blobs, never downloaded images (URLs only) [topic-308744]. Compare against last stored snapshot; no change -> no write.

nodes.name: Write-Delta-Only
nodes.notes: Write only the delta to the delta table / storefront update path. One supplier, one product class, one delta table to start [topic-308744].

nodes.name: Dead-Letter
nodes.notes: Fatal + exhausted items with full attempt log (supplier, SKU/page, profile, outcome, timestamp). Never silently dropped; reviewed by a human on a schedule. A block/CAPTCHA dead-letter also pauses that supplier's queue until a fresh gate pass + new approver record (pattern doc sections 3 and 6).

nodes.name: Alert-Human-On-DeadLetter-Or-Block
nodes.notes: Alert on dead-letter and especially on any block/CAPTCHA. CAPTCHA: NO automated solving against explicit bot controls, period — escalate instead (pattern doc section 6). Human manual solving only, per challenge, logged (date/time, supplier, challenge type, solver name, item/SKU, proceed-or-pause decision). A block pauses that supplier's queue until approver approval after cause understood + robots/ToS re-check re-run; section 3 measures forbidden for resuming the paused scrape.
